name: Multi-Language SCORM Wrapper
tagline: Puts several language versions of one e-learning module into a single SCORM 1.2 package, with a language choice screen.
summary: An open-source package, kept under its MIT licence, for SCORM 1.2, a standard file format for e-learning courses. Learners pick a language, and the module opens in that language. The learning platform sees one course, however many languages are inside.
features: Offer one course in several languages without a separate course for each.
Set the course title, the language screen wording and the default language.
Remember the learner's choice, so they return to the same language next time.
